senses.en: Any longer, usually in negative statements.

ex.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.

col: not live here anymore｜không còn sống ở đây nữa
not need it anymore｜không cần nó nữa
tip: Nghĩa là “không ... nữa”; tiếng Anh Anh thường viết tách any more, và khi nghĩa là “thêm nữa” bắt buộc phải viết tách.

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: I felt ill after the long bus journey.
Employees who are ill should be encouraged to rest rather than return to work immediately.

tip: Khi nghĩa là ốm, ill thường làm vị ngữ: be ill.

senses.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.
A hard mass that forms inside an organ.
The hard central part of some fruits containing the seed.

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.

tip: Chất liệu đá dùng stone không đếm được; một hòn đá là a stone.

senses.en: A city in southwestern England with a historic port.

ex.en: We walked around the harbour in Bristol yesterday.
Bristol provides an interesting example of how historic waterfront areas can be adapted for modern urban life.

col: the city of Bristol｜thành phố Bristol
tip: Nhấn âm ở âm tiết đầu; nằm ở tây nam nước Anh.

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: The whole family celebrated the birth of our daughter.
Access to skilled medical care during birth significantly improves health outcomes for both mothers and newborn babies.

col: give birth to｜sinh ra; dẫn đến
the birth of a movement｜sự ra đời của một phong trào
tip: give birth to nghĩa là sinh con; be born nghĩa là được sinh ra.

senses.en: in the position after ninth and before eleventh
one of ten equal parts of something

ex.en: Our apartment is on the tenth floor of this building.
Only a tenth of the survey participants regularly cycled to work, suggesting considerable scope for improving cycling infrastructure.

col: a tenth of｜một phần mười của
tip: Thứ mười thường dùng the tenth; một phần mười dùng a tenth.

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.

tip: calendar year là từ tháng 1 đến tháng 12, không giống năm học.

senses.en: A toothed tool used to arrange or tidy hair.
To tidy hair with a comb, or search an area thoroughly.

ex.en: She pulled a comb from her bag and tidied her hair.
Volunteers combed the beach for plastic waste before the start of the summer tourist season.

tip: Chữ b cuối không đọc; comb through nghĩa là lục soát kỹ lưỡng.

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.

col: a golf club｜gậy gôn; câu lạc bộ gôn
a round of golf｜một hiệp gôn
tip: Trước tên môn thể thao thường không có mạo từ: play golf.

senses.en: making a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds

ex.en: Our noisy washing machine woke everyone up this morning.
Living near noisy roads can affect sleep quality and increase stress among urban residents.

col: a noisy neighbour｜người hàng xóm ồn ào
a noisy environment｜môi trường ồn ào
a noisy crowd｜đám đông ồn ào
tip: noisy là tính từ, noise là danh từ; đừng nhầm với nosy (tò mò).

senses.en: A long seat designed for several people.
A sturdy table used for practical work.

senses.zh: cho dự bị; không cho ra sân
senses.en: To keep a player out of a game.

ex.en: We shared a park bench and watched the ducks.
Installing benches along pedestrian routes can make city centres more accessible to older residents and people with limited mobility.

col: a park bench｜ghế dài trong công viên
a wooden bench｜ghế dài bằng gỗ
tip: Ghế dài thường không có tựa lưng nhưng không phải lúc nào cũng vậy; bàn làm việc cũng dùng bench.

senses.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.
Information known only to a limited group of people.
An important way of achieving a particular result.

ex.en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.

col: the secret to success｜bí quyết thành công
tip: Bí quyết thường dùng the secret to, sau to là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.

col: a rise in prices｜giá cả tăng
tip: rise là nội động từ, quá khứ rose, quá khứ phân từ risen; raise là ngoại động từ.

senses.zh: ông; thưa ngài (cách gọi tôn trọng)
senses.en: A polite way to address a man or male teacher.
A title used before a knight's or baronet's name.

ex.en: Excuse me, sir, you left your umbrella behind.
In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.

col: excuse me, sir｜xin lỗi, thưa ông
tip: Tước hiệp sĩ dùng Sir kèm tên hoặc họ tên đầy đủ, không dùng Sir với riêng họ.

senses.en: Air moving naturally outdoors.
To wrap something around an object or itself.
To follow a route with many bends and turns.

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.

col: a gust of wind｜một cơn gió
wind a clock｜lên dây cót đồng hồ
tip: Gió đọc /wɪnd/; quấn đọc /waɪnd/, quá khứ là wound.

senses.zh: thuộc Thái Lan; thuộc tiếng Thái
senses.en: relating to Thailand, its people, or its language
the main language spoken in Thailand
a person from Thailand

ex.en: We shared a delicious Thai curry for dinner.
Thai cuisine attracts international visitors and provides valuable opportunities for local restaurants and cooking schools.

tip: Thai luôn viết hoa chữ đầu; tên nước là Thailand.

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I suppose we can eat outside if it stays warm.
Suppose every household used less electricity; the combined reduction in demand could significantly benefit the environment.

col: suppose that｜giả sử là; cho rằng
be supposed to do｜có nhiệm vụ phải; theo kế hoạch thì phải
tip: be supposed to nghĩa là “nên; được cho là phải” hoặc “theo sắp đặt thì phải”.

senses.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches
an area of land covered with trees

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.

col: a piece of wood｜một mảnh gỗ
walk in the woods｜đi dạo trong rừng
tip: Nghĩa “gỗ” không đếm được; nghĩa “rừng” có thể nói a wood hoặc the woods.

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.

senses.zh: tư nhân; thuộc sở hữu riêng
senses.en: Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: Each guest has a private bathroom beside their bedroom.
Private companies can improve public transport, but governments must ensure that fares remain affordable.

tip: in private là riêng tư, kín đáo; in public là công khai.

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: The city now has more than a million residents.
The government plans to invest several million pounds in renewable energy projects over the next decade.

col: two million pounds｜hai triệu bảng Anh
tip: Sau số cụ thể, million không thêm s; millions of nghĩa là hàng triệu.

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought
Playfully funny in a way that is not serious

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.

tip: Thường nhẹ hơn stupid; cũng có thể mang nghĩa đùa vui, không nghiêm túc.

senses.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again

senses.zh: sự sửa chữa; việc bảo trì
senses.en: Work done to restore something damaged or broken
To improve a damaged relationship or put a situation right

ex.en: Can you repair the broken zip on my jacket?
Encouraging consumers to repair household appliances rather than replace them could significantly reduce electronic waste.

col: carry out repairs｜tiến hành sửa chữa
in good repair｜được bảo dưỡng tốt
tip: Việc sửa chữa cụ thể thường dùng số nhiều repairs; beyond repair nghĩa là không thể sửa được.

senses.zh: đóng; đóng cửa; ngừng hoạt động
senses.en: to close something or stop being open for business
closed or not open for business

ex.en: Please shut the window before the rain gets in.
When local libraries shut, residents lose valuable access to free learning resources and shared community spaces.

col: shut down a factory｜đóng cửa nhà máy
keep something shut｜giữ cho (cái gì) đóng kín
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là shut; hiện tại phân từ là shutting.

senses.en: Used when I am both the person acting and receiving.
Used to emphasize that I personally do something.

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.

col: not feel myself｜cảm thấy không khỏe
tip: by myself nghĩa là một mình hoặc tự lập; không dùng myself thay cho chủ ngữ I.

senses.en: before now or earlier than expected

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.

col: already in place｜đã có sẵn; đã được thực hiện
tip: Thường đứng sau trợ động từ và trước động từ chính; nghĩa là “đã” hoặc “sớm hơn dự kiến”.

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.

tip: Uống thuốc dùng take medicine; với nghĩa y học thì không đếm được.

senses.en: not open
not available for business or public use
unwilling to consider different ideas

ex.en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.

col: keep something closed｜giữ (cái gì) đóng kín
closed for repairs｜đóng cửa để sửa chữa
a closed mind｜đầu óc khép kín
tip: Là tính từ nghĩa là “đã đóng”; cũng là quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của close.

senses.en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience.

senses.zh: học vấn; kiến thức uyên bác
senses.en: Knowledge gained through extensive study.

ex.en: Learning becomes easier when I practise a little every day.
Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.

col: a learning environment｜môi trường học tập
a steep learning curve｜đường cong học tập dốc
tip: Thường không đếm được; learning nhấn mạnh quá trình học, còn knowledge nhấn mạnh kiến thức đã nắm.

senses.en: the activity of catching fish for pleasure or food

ex.en: We went fishing by the lake before breakfast.
Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.

col: commercial fishing｜đánh bắt cá thương mại
tip: “Đi câu cá” dùng go fishing, không dùng go to fishing.

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

ex.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.

col: kick a habit｜bỏ một thói quen
tip: kick là đá bằng chân; hit là đánh nói chung, không giới hạn bằng gì.

senses.en: having no doubt about something

senses.zh: chắc chắn xảy ra; nhất định
senses.en: definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I'm certain I left my keys on the kitchen table.
Certain types of public transport are more suitable for densely populated cities than rural areas.

col: certain to happen｜chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra
tip: Khi chủ ngữ là người, certain of là tin chắc; certain to là chắc chắn sẽ.

senses.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject
an area of a shop selling a particular type of product

ex.en: Please ask our sales department about the delivery date.
Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.

tip: Khoa ở đại học có thể dùng department; trường thành viên thường dùng faculty hoặc school.

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver necklace with a tiny bird.
A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.

col: a pearl necklace｜vòng cổ ngọc trai
tip: Phần -lace ở cuối đọc /ləs/, không giống từ lace.

senses.en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet.

senses.zh: dồn vào chân tường; dồn vào thế bí
senses.en: To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.

col: around the corner｜sắp đến; ngay gần
corner the market｜lũng đoạn thị trường
tip: Góc trong phòng dùng in the corner; góc phố thường dùng on hoặc at.

senses.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape
gentle and not loud, bright, or harsh
not strict or severe enough

ex.en: This soft blanket keeps me warm on chilly evenings.
Soft lighting and comfortable furniture can make hospital waiting areas feel less stressful for patients.

tip: soft là tính từ; để bổ nghĩa cho hành động như nói thì thường dùng softly.

senses.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

ex.en: It looked like an ordinary box until we opened it.
Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.

col: an ordinary day｜một ngày bình thường
tip: ordinary nhấn mạnh sự không đặc biệt; không đồng nghĩa với average (mức trung bình).

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The old gun was displayed behind glass at the museum.
Strict gun storage regulations can help prevent accidents and improve safety within local communities.

col: a loaded gun｜khẩu súng đã lên đạn
tip: gun cũng có thể chỉ dụng cụ hình súng, như glue gun (súng bắn keo).

senses.zh: sự chăm sóc; sự điều trị
senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important

senses.zh: sự cẩn thận; sự thận trọng
senses.en: Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.

tip: care about là quan tâm; care for có thể là chăm sóc hoặc thích.

senses.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand

senses.zh: sờ; mân mê bằng ngón tay
senses.en: to touch or handle something with your fingers

ex.en: She wore a silver ring on her middle finger.
Tasks requiring precise finger movements can help young children develop coordination before they learn to write.

col: point a finger at｜chỉ tay vào; đổ lỗi
tip: Thường không gồm ngón cái; ngón cái gọi riêng là thumb.

senses.en: To feel anxious, or make someone feel anxious.
An anxious feeling or something that causes it.

ex.en: I worry about my cat when she stays outside.
Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.

col: a major worry｜một mối lo lớn
financial worries｜những lo lắng về tài chính
tip: worry about nghĩa là lo lắng về điều gì; worried miêu tả trạng thái của người.

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: My sister follows fashion but rarely buys expensive clothes.
The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.

col: in a similar fashion｜theo cách tương tự
tip: Khi nghĩa là “cách thức”, thường dùng in a ... fashion, khá trang trọng.

senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.

tip: Khi là động từ, ship không chỉ vận chuyển đường biển mà còn đường bộ hoặc hàng không.

senses.en: A soft, comfortable shoe worn inside the home.

ex.en: I found my missing slipper underneath the sofa.
Providing slippers in shared accommodation can improve comfort, although regular cleaning remains essential for good hygiene.

col: a pair of slippers｜một đôi dép đi trong nhà
put on your slippers｜xỏ dép đi trong nhà
bedroom slippers｜dép đi trong phòng ngủ
tip: Thường dùng ở số nhiều slippers; dép xỏ ngón gọi là flip-flops.

senses.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable
To a serious or harmful degree
Very much, especially when wanting or needing something

ex.en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.

tip: Dạng so sánh hơn worse, so sánh nhất worst; đây là trạng từ, không phải tính từ bad.

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.

col: lose count｜đếm không xuể; quên đang đếm đến đâu
count on someone｜trông cậy vào ai
every minute counts｜từng phút đều quan trọng
tip: count on nghĩa là dựa vào; khi nghĩa là “quan trọng”, count là nội động từ.

senses.zh: tình hình; tình huống; hoàn cảnh
senses.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.

col: a difficult situation｜một tình huống khó khăn
the current situation｜tình hình hiện tại
deal with a situation｜giải quyết một tình huống
tip: Ở trong một tình huống nào đó thì dùng in a situation.

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.

col: airline pilot｜phi công hãng hàng không
pilot study｜nghiên cứu thử nghiệm ban đầu
pilot a programme｜chạy thử một chương trình
tip: Khi đứng trước danh từ, pilot thường nghĩa là thí điểm, như pilot project.

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.

col: continue to grow｜tiếp tục tăng trưởng
continue a discussion｜tiếp tục cuộc thảo luận
continue as planned｜tiếp tục theo kế hoạch
tip: Có thể theo sau là to do hoặc doing, thường đều nghĩa là tiếp tục làm gì.

senses.en: a large green-skinned fruit with juicy, usually red flesh

ex.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.

col: a slice of watermelon｜một lát dưa hấu
tip: Cả quả dưa hấu đếm được; phần ruột đã cắt thường không đếm được.

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.

col: at the heart of｜nằm ở cốt lõi của
tip: by heart nghĩa là thuộc lòng; lose heart nghĩa là nản lòng.

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.

tip: Tính từ so sánh hơn là drier; dryer là danh từ chỉ máy sấy.

senses.zh: xe tải nhỏ có thùng kín; xe van
senses.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

ex.en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
Replacing diesel delivery vans with electric vehicles could help reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.

col: hire a van｜thuê một chiếc xe van
load a van｜chất hàng lên xe van
tip: Thường chỉ xe chở hàng có thùng kín; đừng nhầm với xe tải thùng hở.

senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.

col: improve your handwriting｜cải thiện chữ viết
tip: Thường không đếm được; nghệ thuật thư pháp dùng calligraphy.

senses.en: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.

col: a round of talks｜một vòng đàm phán
walk round the lake｜đi bộ quanh hồ
tip: Round làm giới từ thường gặp trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng around.

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event

senses.zh: liên hoan nghệ thuật; chuỗi sự kiện
senses.en: An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.

col: celebrate a festival｜tổ chức lễ hội
hold a festival｜tổ chức lễ hội
tip: festival nhấn mạnh sự kiện ăn mừng hoặc một chuỗi hoạt động, không nhất thiết là ngày nghỉ (holiday).

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things

senses.zh: hòa hợp; tạo mối quan hệ tốt với người khác
senses.en: to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.

col: connect to the internet｜kết nối internet
connect A with B｜liên kết A với B
connect with people｜kết nối với mọi người
tip: Kết nối thiết bị thường dùng connect A to B.

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.

col: receive a warm welcome｜được chào đón nồng nhiệt
tip: receive nhấn mạnh việc nhận được; accept nhấn mạnh việc sẵn lòng chấp nhận.

senses.zh: đi bộ đường dài; đi bộ leo núi
senses.en: Taking long walks outdoors, especially in the countryside.

ex.en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
Hiking offers an affordable way to improve physical health while encouraging people to appreciate natural landscapes.

col: hiking boots｜giày đi bộ đường dài
hiking equipment｜dụng cụ đi bộ đường dài
tip: Thường chỉ việc đi bộ đường dài ở vùng quê; cũng là hiện tại phân từ của hike.

senses.en: Having hair that is pale yellow or golden.
A person with pale yellow or golden hair.

ex.en: His blond hair looked almost white in the sunshine.
In discussions of inherited traits, blond hair is often used as an example of human physical variation.

col: a blond child｜đứa trẻ tóc vàng
tip: blonde thường dùng cho nữ; nghĩa không ám chỉ màu da.

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.

col: leave a mark｜để lại dấu vết
tip: Điểm thi thường dùng số nhiều marks, đặc biệt trong tiếng Anh Anh.

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.

col: huge difference｜sự khác biệt rất lớn
tip: Bản thân đã mang nghĩa “cực lớn”; có thể nhấn mạnh thêm bằng absolutely huge.

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.

col: a flu outbreak｜đợt bùng phát cúm
tip: flu thường không đếm được; tiếng Anh Anh hay nói have flu, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường thêm the.

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.

tip: Nội dung quảng cáo dùng for; advertising chỉ hoạt động quảng cáo nói chung.

senses.zh: khúc côn cầu (trên cỏ); khúc côn cầu trên băng
senses.en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck

ex.en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.

col: field hockey｜khúc côn cầu trên cỏ
ice hockey｜khúc côn cầu trên băng
tip: Ở Anh thường chỉ khúc côn cầu trên cỏ; ở Mỹ thường chỉ khúc côn cầu trên băng.

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.

senses.zh: sự việc ngẫu nhiên; sự tình cờ
senses.en: Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.

col: a road accident｜một vụ tai nạn giao thông
tip: by accident nghĩa là vô tình; cụm trái nghĩa là on purpose.

senses.zh: bài diễn văn; bài phát biểu
senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.

col: freedom of speech｜quyền tự do ngôn luận
opening speech｜bài phát biểu khai mạc
tip: Một bài phát biểu dùng a speech; khả năng nói thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.

col: the shore of a lake｜bờ hồ
tip: on the lake chỉ ở trên mặt hồ; in the lake chỉ ở trong nước hồ.

senses.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

ex.en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.

col: a short paragraph｜một đoạn văn ngắn
tip: Danh từ đếm được; trong bài viết, thường mỗi đoạn xoay quanh một ý chính.

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.

col: a chance to learn｜cơ hội để học
a good chance of｜khả năng cao là
take a chance｜liều thử một phen
tip: Cơ hội thường dùng chance to do; khả năng thường dùng chance of doing.

senses.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
Sightseeing tours can support local economies, especially when visitors choose guides and businesses from the community.

col: a sightseeing tour｜chuyến tham quan ngắm cảnh
a sightseeing bus｜xe buýt tham quan
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; nói go sightseeing, không thêm a.

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.

tip: Giữ liên lạc với ai dùng keep in touch with someone.

senses.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.

ex.en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.

tip: Một bức vẽ là đếm được; hoạt động vẽ thường không đếm được.

senses.en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.

col: fruit dessert｜món tráng miệng trái cây
tip: dessert có hai chữ s, nhấn âm sau; desert là sa mạc thì nhấn âm đầu.

senses.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace
a container used to carry drinking water outdoors

ex.en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
Providing affordable healthy meals in the workplace canteen can improve employee wellbeing and productivity.

col: a water canteen｜bình nước mang theo
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh thường chỉ nhà ăn; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng cafeteria.

senses.zh: thợ xây; nhà thầu xây dựng
senses.en: A person or company that constructs or repairs buildings.

ex.en: The builder replaced the broken bricks around our doorway.
Builders can reduce construction waste by choosing durable materials and planning resource use more carefully.

col: local builder｜nhà thầu xây dựng địa phương
house builder｜nhà xây dựng nhà ở
tip: Có thể chỉ thợ xây hoặc công ty xây dựng nhà.

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.

col: solve a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: solve đi thẳng với vấn đề; “hòa tan” là dissolve.

senses.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.
To move or serve food using a spoon.

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.

col: spoon into a bowl｜múc vào bát
tip: Một thìa đầy thường nói a spoonful of.

senses.zh: không đồng ý; bất đồng ý kiến
senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.

col: disagree with someone｜không đồng ý với ai
disagree about something｜bất đồng về điều gì
strongly disagree｜hoàn toàn không đồng ý
tip: Không đồng ý với ai dùng disagree with; chủ đề tranh cãi dùng on hoặc about.

senses.en: A code identifying a postal delivery area in the United States.

ex.en: Please include your ZIP code when entering your address.
Researchers grouped households by ZIP code to examine geographical differences in access to healthcare services.

col: enter a ZIP code｜nhập mã bưu chính
ZIP code lookup｜tra cứu mã bưu chính
ZIP code area｜khu vực mã bưu chính
tip: Dùng ở Mỹ; Anh thường nói postcode, còn cách gọi chung là postal code.
note: Đã chuẩn hóa cách viết không chuẩn zipcode thành ZIP code.

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.

col: the author of a novel｜tác giả của một cuốn tiểu thuyết
a bestselling author｜tác giả sách bán chạy
author a report｜viết một bản báo cáo
tip: Tác giả của ... dùng the author of; cũng có thể làm động từ.

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.

col: a bar of soap｜một bánh xà phòng
liquid soap｜xà phòng nước; nước rửa tay
soap and water｜xà phòng và nước
soap opera｜phim truyền hình dài tập
tip: Chỉ chất làm sạch thì thường không đếm được; một bánh dùng a bar of soap.

senses.en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.

col: frozen peas｜đậu Hà Lan đông lạnh
tip: Danh từ đếm được; khi nói chung về món ăn thường dùng số nhiều peas.

senses.en: Having many bright colours
Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.

col: a colourful display｜màn trình bày rực rỡ
a colourful character｜một nhân vật thú vị độc đáo
a colourful history｜lịch sử phong phú
tip: Anh Anh viết colourful, Anh Mỹ viết colorful.

senses.en: as stated or reported by someone or something
following a rule, plan, or particular standard

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.

col: according to the rules｜theo quy tắc
tip: Dẫn quan điểm của người khác dùng according to; quan điểm của mình dùng in my opinion.

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.

tip: Động từ bất quy tắc: throw – threw – thrown; throw cũng dùng để nói tổ chức tiệc.

senses.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.
Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person.
Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.

col: nasty comment｜lời nhận xét ác ý
tip: Mạnh hơn bad, mang sắc thái ghê tởm; khi tả người thường chỉ người ác ý, không tử tế.

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.

col: explain something to someone｜giải thích điều gì cho ai
explain in detail｜giải thích chi tiết
explain the difference｜giải thích sự khác biệt
tip: Nói explain something to someone, không nói explain someone.

senses.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.

senses.zh: có thể nào; bằng mọi cách
senses.en: Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.

ex.en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.

tip: can't possibly nghĩa là “không thể nào”, sắc thái rất mạnh.

senses.en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins.
Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver.
A medal awarded for second place in a competition.

ex.en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.

tip: Khi chỉ kim loại bạc thì không đếm được; a silver có thể là một tấm huy chương bạc.

senses.zh: bản sao; một cuốn; một bản
senses.en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document
To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions
Written material prepared for publication or advertising

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.

col: a digital copy｜bản sao điện tử
copy and paste｜sao chép và dán
tip: Số nhiều là copies; copy với nghĩa nội dung quảng cáo thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: việc đi lại; việc du lịch
senses.en: The activity of going from one place to another
Moving between places rather than staying in one location
Going from one place to another

ex.en: Travelling by train gives me time to enjoy the scenery.
Travelling abroad can broaden students' perspectives by exposing them to different customs and ways of life.

col: travelling abroad｜đi du lịch nước ngoài
a travelling exhibition｜triển lãm lưu động
tip: Anh Anh viết gấp đôi chữ l; Anh Mỹ thường viết traveling.

senses.zh: một cách khác; theo cách khác
senses.en: in a way that is not the same

ex.en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
Students learn differently, so teachers should offer varied activities rather than rely on a single method.

col: treat someone differently｜đối xử khác biệt với ai
do things differently｜làm việc theo cách khác
tip: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ; khi tả người hoặc vật khác nhau thì dùng different.

senses.zh: cảnh sát; sĩ quan cảnh sát
senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.

col: chief executive officer｜giám đốc điều hành
tip: officer có thể chỉ cảnh sát hoặc sĩ quan; nghĩa cụ thể tùy cụm từ đi kèm.

senses.en: a large black and white bear native to China

ex.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.

col: panda habitat｜môi trường sống của gấu trúc
tip: panda thường chỉ gấu trúc lớn; red panda là gấu trúc đỏ.

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things

senses.zh: trải nghiệm; điều đã trải qua
senses.en: something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.

col: a rewarding experience｜một trải nghiệm bổ ích
tip: Nghĩa “kinh nghiệm” không đếm được; nghĩa “trải nghiệm” cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.

col: an increase in demand｜nhu cầu tăng
a significant increase｜mức tăng đáng kể
tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau, danh từ nhấn âm đầu; by đi với mức tăng, to đi với giá trị cuối cùng.

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.

col: belong in a museum｜đáng được đặt trong bảo tàng
feel you belong｜cảm thấy mình thuộc về
tip: belong to nghĩa là thuộc về, không dùng ở thể bị động hoặc thì tiếp diễn.

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.

col: almost every day｜hầu như mỗi ngày
tip: almost có thể đi với all, every và no; không đi trực tiếp với most.

senses.en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.

ex.en: My grandfather still uses a tape-recorder to record songs.
Before digital devices became widespread, researchers often used a tape-recorder to preserve interviews for later analysis.

col: a portable tape-recorder｜máy ghi âm cầm tay
a cassette tape-recorder｜máy ghi âm băng cassette
tip: Cách viết hiện đại thường là tape recorder, không có dấu gạch nối.

senses.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.

senses.zh: đúng vậy; hoàn toàn chính xác
senses.en: Used to confirm that something is completely correct.

ex.en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.

col: exactly the same｜hoàn toàn giống nhau
tip: not exactly thường nghĩa là “không hẳn”, cũng có thể dùng để phủ định nhẹ nhàng.
